title: Consume NEXT_HARNESS eval data as a third diagnose/remediate input source
rationale: LLM_OPS today only reads harness_agent_runs (runtime failures) and the optimizations backlog. The NEXT_HARNESS eval system writes results to the SAME Postgres (harness_eval_runs + harness_eval_results, via the same MCP execute_sql bridge) and commits a regression floor at evals/baseline.json, but LLM_OPS is blind to it. That means quality and safety regressions the nightly eval would catch (success rate below floor, passHatK reliability drop, or any safety violation) never reach the diagnose->remediate->PR pipeline that already exists. Reading eval data closes that gap: a breached baseline becomes an eval finding (signature eval::<suite>::<metric>) that flows through the same agent->commit->push->PR->ledger machinery, PR-only.
details: Mirror lib/runs-repository.ts for ingestion (lib/evals-repository.ts, read-only, callMcpTool('execute_sql') + lib/sql.ts escaping, LOCAL mirror of EvalRunMetrics — never import from NEXT_HARNESS). Add HARNESS_EVAL_RUNS_TABLE, HARNESS_EVAL_RESULTS_TABLE, HARNESS_EVAL_BASELINE_PATH, HARNESS_EVAL_SUITES to lib/config.ts (evalSuites defaults to ['agent']). Add lib/baseline.ts (read ${repoPath}/evals/baseline.json; null threshold = skip; always flag safetyViolationRate > 0) and lib/diagnose-evals.ts (regressions -> EvalFinding with signature eval::<suite>::<metric>, metric-specific suggestedFix, reuse Ledger + newFindings for recurrence). Wire an 'Eval regressions' section into scripts/report.ts and a third work-item stream into scripts/remediate.ts (PR-only, excluded from --auto-merge in the first cut). Add vitest coverage for baseline comparison (null-skip, safety ceiling, boundary equality), diagnose-evals (grouping/signatures/recurrence), and evals-repository SQL escaping with a mocked callMcpTool. Update README.md (two -> three kinds of work item) and docs/RUNBOOK.md. First cut scope: agent suite + success/reliability/safety metrics only. See docs/DESIGN-consume-harness-evals.md.
